shape_keys.name: Basis
shape_keys.physics: quasi-ordered, large three-color domains, sharp domain walls

shape_keys.name: SK_Critical
shape_keys.physics: critical point c=4/5 CFT, fractal mosaic, G(r) ~ r^{-(1-eta)}, eta=4/15

shape_keys.name: SK_HotCrit
shape_keys.physics: above Tc, short-range clusters, exponential correlations

shape_keys.name: SK_HighT
shape_keys.physics: fully disordered, equal populations of all three states

physics.model: 2D classical q=3 Potts model on square lattice
physics.algorithm: checkerboard Metropolis, proposal uniform from {0,1,2}, N^2/2 decisions per half-sweep
physics.Tc: J / ln(1 + sqrt(3)) = 0.9950 J/k_B (Wu 1982 Rev. Mod. Phys. 54:235)
physics.first_order_boundary: q >= 5 gives discontinuous (first-order) transition; q=2,3,4 continuous
physics.height_field: sigma/(q-1), mapped to [0, Z_SCALE]; 3 distinct levels → terrace landscape

outside_sources.title: Some generalized order-disorder transformations

outside_sources.note: Original paper introducing the q-state generalisation of the Ising model

outside_sources.title: The Potts model
